title: Need Guidance on how to release demo
author: Any_Excitement7386
selftext:
So I am new to creating game and I created a game. I need some guidance like I have a working demo and I have shared with 2-3 people only and based on feedback I have resolved the bugs and everything and now I am confused on how to put it in front of everyone like should I first create a page on itch and open it for everyone to play or should I go ahead and release it on steam as a demo.  
Like what will be the best way to go with it.  
My game is pixel art top down survival game set after the apocalypse, where you scavenge, fight off zombie hordes  
and yeah there is a story too.

comments.author: TalkingPixelsStudio
comments.body: Feel free to list it here https://www.talkingpixels.games
